collection: Mumbai Multi-Source Precipitation and Rain Gauge Datasets

datasets.dataset: Historical Multi-Year Hourly Rain Gauge Observations (2015–2025)
datasets.source: India Meteorological Department (IMD) & Open-Meteo Historical Archive
datasets.license: IMD Open Public Domain / Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
datasets.coverage: Mumbai Island City and Suburban zones
datasets.limitations: Point measurements require spatial interpolation (Kriging, Thiessen polygons, or Barnes objective analysis) across the 24 wards.
datasets.processing: Structured with ISO 8601 UTC timestamps, numerical rainfall amounts in millimeters, and quality verification flags.

datasets.source: IMD National Data Centre / BMC Disaster Management Department
datasets.limitations: 2005 event exhibits extreme spatial gradient (944.2 mm at Santacruz vs. 73.4 mm at Colaba), illustrating convective micro-burst phenomenon.
datasets.processing: Calibrated against official recorded daily totals and published scientific literature.

datasets.dataset: NASA Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM) IMERG Half-Hourly Gridded Product (V07)
datasets.source: NASA Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center (GES DISC)
datasets.license: NASA Open Data Policy (Free and open worldwide)
datasets.limitations: Spatial resolution (10 km) cannot capture street-canyon microphysics; requires downscaling or bias correction using ground AWS gauges.
datasets.processing: Spatially subset for Mumbai coordinates; calibrated precipitation rates in mm/hr.

datasets.source: Meteorological and Oceanographic Satellite Data Archival Centre (MOSDAC) / ISRO
datasets.license: ISRO Data Policy (Free access for registered users/researchers)
datasets.limitations: Geostationary thermal infrared and water vapor estimates undergo cloud-top temperature brightness attenuation; optimal when combined with Doppler Weather Radar.
datasets.processing: Extracted matrix of rainfall rates over Mumbai bounding box.
